en: "Space Battleship Yamato 2199" Plastic model is a must-have for fans!
Introducing special photo-etched parts to improve the details of 1/500 Scale Space Battleship Yamato 2199!
Exclusive photo-etched parts to improve the details of Bandai Plastic Model "1/500 Scale Space Battleship Yamato 2199" (sold separately).
With the precise shape and texture unique to metal, it is possible to express more realistic and sharp details.
• Size: 270mm x 185mm (Scheduled)
• Material: Stainless steel (Scheduled)
• Can be painted (*The finished product in the photo is an example of unassembled/unpainted assembly)
* "1/500 Space Battleship Yamato 2199" (sold separately) 'before assembly' is required to install photo-etched parts.
There is a place where the photo-etched parts are attached in the middle of the assembly of the main body.
*In order to install photo-etched parts, some parts on the main body side may require cutting or other processing.
* Adhesive such as instant adhesive (sold separately) is required to assemble photo-etched parts.
*To cut out photo-etched parts and reproduce three-dimensional shapes, tools such as etched-part scissors, metal files, pliers, tweezers, etc. (sold separately) are required.
Recommended for use.
*When painting, please prepare paint for the model (sold separately). We also recommend using a primer (sold separately).
《Plastic model "1/500 Space Battleship Yamato 2199" is not included with this product. 》
Photo-etched parts for plastic models
